summary: Field Shift is an AI-powered adaptive farming platform designed to help farmers make smarter agricultural decisions using NASA data and satellite-based insights. It analyzes important environmental factors such as soil moisture, rainfall, temperature, vegetation health, and land conditions to provide location-based farming recommendations. The platform offers an interactive map, crop suitability analysis, seasonal crop recommendations, crop rotation guidance, and an AI-powered farming assistant called Bhoomi AI to answer farmers' questions. It aims to make complex agricultural and satellite information simple and accessible through a user-friendly interface. By combining AI and Earth observation data, Field Shift supports sustainable farming, better resource management, improved soil health, and informed crop planning. Our goal is to empower farmers with accessible technology and encourage climate-smart agriculture.
details:
Field Shift is an AI-powered adaptive farming platform that combines NASA Earth observation data with artificial intelligence to support smarter agricultural decisions. It provides an interactive map, location-based environmental analysis, crop suitability recommendations, seasonal crop planning, and crop rotation guidance. Farmers can explore factors such as rainfall, temperature, soil moisture, and vegetation conditions to better understand their land.

The platform also includes Bhoomi AI, an intelligent farming assistant that helps users understand agricultural information, answer farming-related questions, and receive guidance in multiple languages.

We developed the project using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Firebase, and Gemini AI. The interface is designed to be simple, interactive, and farmer-friendly.

Our creative approach is to make complex satellite and environmental information understandable and useful for everyday farming. The project aims to encourage sustainable agriculture, improve resource management, and help farmers make informed decisions in changing climate conditions.
